title: Da Lat in a day
summary: A town day from Xuan Huong Lake through the market, the cathedral, the college gate on Yersin, and the station, then Crazy House and Lam Vien Square.

stops.name: Xuan Huong Lake
stops.note: A loop of the shore takes 45 to 90 minutes.

stops.name: Da Lat Market
stops.note: Strawberries, flowers, and the counters in the sloping halls.

stops.name: Da Lat Cathedral
stops.note: The rooster tower on Tran Phu.

approach.note: Walk from the lake to Tran Phu.

stops.name: Da Lat Education College
stops.note: The colonnade and the bell tower from the pavement on Yersin.

stops.name: Da Lat Railway Station
stops.note: The art-deco hall takes 30 to 60 minutes without the train.

approach.note: Walk or take a taxi from the lake.

stops.name: Crazy House
stops.note: The concrete rooms and bridges take 45 to 60 minutes.

approach.note: Taxi or Grab from the lake to 03 Huynh Thuc Khang.

stops.name: Lam Vien Square
stops.note: The paved square on the lake edge.

approach.note: Walk from the lake to Tran Quoc Toan.

additions.name: Linh Phuoc Pagoda
additions.note: The mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, by the tourist train from the station or by road.

additions.name: Bao Dai Palace III
additions.note: The hill villa at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, about 2.5 km south of the centre.

additions.name: Truc Lam Zen Monastery
additions.note: The gardens on Phoenix Hill, with the cable car from Robin Hill.

additions.name: Datanla Falls
additions.note: The waterfall on Prenn Pass, south of the centre.

additions.name: Langbiang Mountain
additions.note: The mountain north of town at 93A Bidoup, a half-day from the centre.

seoDescription: One day in Da Lat: Xuan Huong Lake, the market, the cathedral, the college on Yersin, the station, Crazy House, and Lam Vien Square.
